name: Architecture Decision Record
description: Example prompt for drafting a concise architecture decision record from explicit context, constraints, and evaluated options.

prompt.template: Draft an architecture decision record for DECISION. Use CONTEXT and CONSTRAINTS as facts. Compare OPTIONS fairly, state the selected option and tradeoffs, and list consequences and follow-up actions. Do not invent benchmarks or stakeholder approval.

variables.name: DECISION
variables.description: The decision that needs to be recorded.

variables.name: CONSTRAINTS
variables.description: Known limits such as cost, compatibility, or timing.

usage.instructions: Replace every uppercase variable with reviewed project facts, then ask a decision owner to verify the resulting tradeoffs and status.
usage.example: DECISION: Choose the client-side router. CONTEXT: Static GitHub Pages app. CONSTRAINTS: No server rewrites. OPTIONS: BrowserRouter, HashRouter.
